product_one_liner.value: Aikido provides an automated, developer-first security platform that finds and helps fix risks across code, cloud, and runtime for software development and security teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as securing what developers build, ship, and run, with security findings and fixes across the software lifecycle.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists plans, including a free Developer plan and paid plans.

named_customers.notes: The customer stories page names all three; separate customer pages/posts also document Revolut and Visma.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn places the company in the 201–500 employee band; Aikido's About page reports 350+ employees, consistent with that band.

hq_location.notes: Aikido identifies its European headquarters in Ghent, Belgium. It also lists a US headquarters in San Francisco; Ghent is the company's Belgian headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile identifies 2022 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains company/product announcements and general security and marketing content. I did not find at least two posts both explaining how Aikido builds its product and attributable to engineers, as required for a true answer.

public_docs.notes: Aikido has a public help center with multiple product guides and a separate developer/API documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers posting is titled AI Engineer; the job board also lists AI-focused security and development positions.

model_provider.value: Aikido publicly names Aikido Altar, its open-weight security model, as built from Z.AI's GLM-5.3. It does not identify a single provider for all of Aikido's AI features.
model_provider.notes: The Altar announcement identifies the model's GLM-5.3 basis and Z.AI provenance. Aikido's general AI-use documentation describes its AI capabilities but does not name a universal model/provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 compliance and states GDPR compliance. ISO 42001 is also named on the page but is outside the certification options specified in the question.

last_funding.notes: Aikido announced a $60 million Series B on January 14, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $60 million Series B announced in January 2026 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Business Development Representative and Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Aikido announced the Noon workforce-security product on October 20, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Maarten De Schuymer's profile lists his Aikido VP Product role beginning in June 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Aikido's SMB Account Manager job description explicitly names HubSpot and Salesforce as examples of CRM systems.
